A.Module 1: Week 1 Thread: How to Look at the Bible Discussion Learning Log 1.)“With all this in mind, we can see that God’s plan reveals we are terribly lost and in need of rescue.”He could have said we were too much work, or we constantly make mistakes.
I see the unyielding love with the price paid to rescue us.
He made a choice not to turn his back on us and that is huge.John Cartwright and Chris Hulshof, Everyday Bible Study: Growing in the Christian Faith, ed.

Gabriel Etzel and Ben Gutierrez, 2nd edition., Everyday Bible Series (Nashville, TN: B&H Academic, 2019), 5.2.)“We cannot live a life of total obedience at every turn and in every moment.”This is complete truth.
I have tried to be obedient and live the life according to his word.
It worked for awhile but then things started to build up and eventually things spiraled.
I am not submissive enough.

I love him and he knows what he created so I just try my best and that is good enough now because anything more just causes discontent in our household.John Cartwright and Chris Hulshof, Everyday Bible Study: Growing in the Christian Faith, ed.

Gabriel Etzel and Ben Gutierrez, 2nd edition., Everyday Bible Series (Nashville, TN: B&H Academic, 2019), 6.3.)“To effectively discuss an event or topic, it is helpful and necessary to have a firm grasp on the historical context of that event or topic.”I agree completely that one must know a topic well to discuss it.
I enjoy looking up the historical context and getting the backstory on different place and events.
I feel like there is a gap or something is missing without that context included in the discussion.
